comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Concurrency test with two PATCHers on different fields both succeed with sequential versions.

content.text: Concurrency test with two PATCHers on different fields both succeed with sequential versions.
PATCH was missing for issues, so clients had to PUT the full resource and risked clobbering concurrent edits to unrelated fields.

Support PATCH /v2/issues/{id} with a partial JSON object; only provided fields are validated and written. Unset fields remain unchanged. Use merge semantics for maps like custom_fields (shallow merge by key).
Acceptance: patching summary alone does not clear description; unknown fields 400; ETag / If-Match still enforced; OpenAPI and SDK updated.
